title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode10 Smiling, Sparkling Show

meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to say, it was pretty clever of Emu to throw our farewell party at Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is where everything began for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu said that she came up with a plan, but I wonder what she's gonna have us do today...
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: We have arrived seven minutes early.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Rui... And Robo-Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You brought Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is the first time all four of us are meeting in quite some time. Robo-Nene seemed to want to see all of you.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. It is nice to see you two again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's good to hear... Let's have a good time together today, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That just leaves Emu.
Knowing her, I doubt she's going to be late or anything...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, could she be right on cue...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Looks like it. Lemme see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I'm running late because we ran into some trouble”...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's also saying that we can start going around the park since it might take a while to deal with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you think happened?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
She just sent another message.
Apparently, something is happening with the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Trouble with the stage...?
I suppose Emu's hands are sort of tied here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, is everything going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We don't know what's actually going on, but if a show is in danger of getting canceled...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Isn't there some way we can help...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know going over might just mean us getting in the way. But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We may not know exactly what's happening, but there's a chance we'll be able to provide her with some assistance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's go over to where Emu is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Understood.
I'll let the Phoenix Stage staff know what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, and thank you very much!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Which stages do I still need to contact...?)
se_run_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What are you guys doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You said something about running into trouble here. Can you tell us what's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, umm... The thing is, the Wonder Stage cast flew over to do a traveling performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But the flight they were supposed to catch this morning got canceled. That means they won't be back in time for today's show.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Certain parts of the country experienced rough weather this morning.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But what do you plan on doing if you know the cast isn't gonna make it back in time...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been trying to get a hold of cast members from the other stages to fill in for them, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like you haven't had much success...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
They all have their own shows to perform, and they'd have basically no time to practice or rehearse.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought about canceling the show altogether, but I also don't want to disappoint all the guests looking forward to seeing a show at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Based on the backdrops and such, this show is supposed to take place in a forest, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seems like it.
Could you show me what props you have available right now, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: S-Sure, they're over here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And these look like all the costumes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm seeing some things from when we were still performing here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is the clown's wand, and here's a cape that could be used for the alchemist... Everything's been treated with such care.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I believe we have everything we need in order to put on that show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, what a coincidence!
I was just thinking the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wh-What are you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, let us put on a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As luck would have it, we all have plenty of experience performing on this stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Plus, we can use the props and costumes we have right here to put on that show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. If it's a show the four of us have done before, then we won't need much time to practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, could you ask for any better replacements than us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: B-But I invited you guys to Phoenix Wonderland because I wanted you to all have fun and enjoy yourselves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That won't be a problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, there really is nothing more fun than us doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you have guests waiting to see a show, no...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means we need to make putting smiles on their faces our priority. That is why we perform on stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let us help, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really want us to do a show together, since it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will also help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
Let's start getting everything ready!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Is it true that Wonderlands×Showtime is doing a show today...?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! It was apparently organized last-minute, but I'm so excited about seeing them do a show again...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The crowd's starting to gather...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, this is exhilarating.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I honestly wasn't expecting the four of us to stand on this stage together again...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so excited...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go out there and make them all smile from ear to ear☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, it's almost time for us to go on.
Take your places, and...

Hello, everyone!
Tonight we have a special performance guaranteed to put a smile on your face♪
Are you ready to put on a good show for the audience?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What was that just now...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Did you also hear it, Nene?
Who said those things just now...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't know, but I feel really encouraged now for some reason... Like they were cheering us on☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, there is no doubt that they were here to give us all a boost of energy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take this strange phenomenon, go out there and put on an incredible show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's time for Wonderlands×Showtime's performance to start!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “Once upon a time, there was an eccentric traveling theatre troupe. The troupe consists of a show-offy troupe leader...”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “A clown who won't listen...”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “And a songstress who can't sing in public.”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “The oddball group staged many shows, but they never managed to attract an audience.”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “Then one day, as they were traveling through a forest, they encountered an alchemist who was performing a show all alone.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Haha. They really are all oddballs!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: What do you think is gonna happen...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This show is where everything began for us.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It let us truly get to know each other, and because of that, we were able to grow and perform on stage together...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Now, we just need to do what we did back then. Act, sing and make everybody smile.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (On our beloved Wonder Stage...!)

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “Why aren't you singing now? You sang beautiful songs in the forest before...”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “Th-That's because I knew no one else was around...”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“Argh! Enough!
I'm just saying that you should try singing right now! The villagers have already told me about how incredible your voice is!”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “Uhh... I-I'd probably sound terrible right now. But...”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “Do you think I can really change...?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My legs wobbled so much when we did this show for this first time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm not afraid of standing on stage at all now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The others helped make that change happen.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because we put on so many different shows together...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wow... Her voice is so pretty...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It really is beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can tell just how much she's been working on her singing.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And it's not just Nene. Tsukasa's acting skills have also improved quite a bit. They've both grown so much as actors...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. So...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As the director, I need to respond to my actors in kind!)

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “At this rate, nobody is going to hear her singing. For our songstress, I'll put together a useful contraption...”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line:
“And how about you?
You said you're the leader of your troupe. That must mean you're good at one or two things, no...?”

rows.Speaker: Alchemist
rows.Line: “How would you feel about doing a scene that involves battling against this dragon contraption? It should make for an excellent show.”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Cool! You could do shows about big adventures and stuff☆”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“Easily done!
Watch as I elegantly take flight!”
*Roar*

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Whoa! That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
He got to the other side so fast!
And it only took him a couple of leaps!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wow. He was already pretty acrobatic, but his technique is so polished now...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I know we prepared that springboard for him, but still... Those movements were extraordinary.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only did he fly incredibly high, he drew the audience's attention by keeping a tight form and moving dynamically to stick the landing...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. The Wonder Stage is full of smiles and laughter...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Nene's singing, Tsukasa's acting and Rui's directing are just like old times.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, they're better and more exciting than ever...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “Noooooooo!!!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Oh no...! Did he fall...?

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “Darn it! How long has this hole been here...?”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “However, as the leader of the Pegasus Troupe, I am not about to give up! I just need to use the contraption that alchemist made for me and...! Juuuump!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Oh, he's back!
Wait, he has wings now?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. Thankfully, there's plenty of space beneath the stage.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Despite this stunt being a last-minute addition, Tsukasa did a nice job of falling in... We couldn't have asked for a better reaction from the audience.)

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “Please, believe me this time! With our next show, we can spread joy to everyone around us!”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line:
“So...
Won't you join my troupe again?”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Then, let's do a show together!”

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “You can sing for us, Songstress, you can dance for us, Troupe Leader, and you can come up with lots of fun ideas for us as the director, Alchemist.”

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line:
“Spread joy to everyone around us, huh...?
We don't really have a choice at this point, do we?”

rows.Speaker: Troupe Leader
rows.Line: “No, because that is the sole purpose of the Pegasus Troupe!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Things are always so fun and exciting whenever we do a show together...☆)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And everything turns all sparkly.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The smiles on the guests' faces, and the Wonder Stage.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That's probably because...)

rows.Speaker: Songstress
rows.Line: “Come on, Clown! Let's dance together!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Together...

rows.Speaker: Clown
rows.Line: “Okay...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm here with them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because I get to stand on stage with them again.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That's why everyone and everything looks a lot more sparkly today...!)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “And so, this show was able to add more laughter to the village, moment by moment.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is the climax...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We've reached the final act before the show comes to a close...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, I don't want it to end...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That also means I need to enjoy every second of this...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And make the entire crowd here smile from ear to ear...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. We're...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The four of us are chasing after our dreams together...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Alright, there are far too many questions that require answering here... But for now, we need to focus on finishing this show...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Let's all have fun until the very end!)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “And they made shows together forever after...”

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “The end.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This view is truly...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming to visit the park today!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Honestly, I came running over because I heard they were having trouble...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But they're receiving a massive round of applause.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. I'm glad they were able to see their show through.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Keisuke?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... I hadn't seen them do a show in so long...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I couldn't help but feel moved by their performance...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...
